  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 11:00 AM

Al Austin II, Chair
Charles Parkin, Member

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO

CALL TO ORDER

REGULAR AGENDA

  Department’s non-operational properties.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-57248  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the Long Beach Public Utilities
  Department’s (LBPUD) Fire Hydrant Inspection Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.
